name: Mid-band regime sweet-spot arms short-burst momentum (between-gate, not a single floor)
rationale: THESIS: A risk-on macro regime is not monotonically good for momentum. At the LOW end the tide is out and trend is a trap; at the EXTREME-HIGH end the composite is in a stretched euphoric state that mean-reverts (peak liquidity = peak fragility). The exploitable window is the MID-BAND — risk premia are being paid but the regime is not yet over-extended — where a short 7d momentum burst continues cleanly. macro_regime is BOUNDED so a two-sided between-band is the honest encoding. We arm a fast ret_Nd burst only inside [regime_lo, regime_hi]. DISCONFIRMER: re-run with the between-band replaced by a single gt floor at regime_lo (drop the upper rail). If the one-sided floor reproduces the band's net-of-fee Sharpe, the upper de-risking rail carries no information and this is just a floor-gate dressed as a band — falsified. The band must beat both the one-sided floor AND ungated 7d momentum.
catalyst: Macro composite enters the mid-band sweet spot (risk-on but not over-extended) while a fast 7d-ish trend is positive — the window arms a short momentum burst.
